gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.187: Soaked through, you burn less but feel the cold and the lightning more, and iron left wet rusts for good. Scrub off old blood standing in water: sneak and use a straw wisp or a handful of sand. Blood on a floor or wall comes off the same way with a bucket or bottle of water in your other hand, or a wet sponge; pouring water over it washes it away.
